chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'Is the prayer in the house of Fatima (peace be upon her) superior, or in the Garden?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'In the house of Fatima (peace be upon her)'.
ai.seo_question: Which is more virtuous: praying in the house of Fatima or in the Rawdah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explicitly prioritizes the prayer in the house of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) over the Garden of the Prophet (al-Rawdah), affirming the unique spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt's residence. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly view that the sanctity of the Prophet's family extends beyond their burial sites to their lived spaces, making them focal points for devotion and barakah.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Is the Salaat prayed in the house of Syeda Fatimaasws superior or if prayed in the Garden?’ Heasws said: ‘(The one prayed) in the house of Syeda Fatimaasws’.
en.sarwar: 13. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya’qub who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘Is performing salat (prayer) in the house of Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, more virtuous or in al-Rawdah?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Performing salat (prayer) in the house of Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, is more virtuous.’”
